+ import time
+ class TokenBucket:
+     def __init__(self, capacity, rate):
+         self.capacity = capacity
+         self.rate = rate
+         self.tokens = capacity
+         self.last = time.time()
+     def consume(self, n=1):
+         now = time.time()
+         self.tokens = min(self.capacity, self.tokens + (now - self.last) * self.rate)
+         self.last = now
+         if self.tokens >= n:
+             self.tokens -= n
+             return True
+         return False
